verdict.rationale: Sill keeps almost nothing: it has no account and no server, and screen content and keystrokes travel only between the user's own devices. Its privacy page also documents deleting the records it does keep, by forgetting a paired Mac on the device or removing paired devices in Settings › Devices on the Mac. Missing for 10: any retention settings or policy for local logs (only a log folder location is given), a way to wipe all local settings and data, documented retention periods, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: There is no account and no server: your screen and what you type travel only between your own devices
To forget one Mac you paired, touch and hold its row on the connect screen and choose Forget.
You can remove any of them in Sill’s Settings › Devices on your Mac.
